name: @brainervirus/opencode-commandcode
description: Command Code API provider for opencode — use Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, and Step models via Command Code
author: Brent Weatherall

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src scripts plugin.ts index.ts tests
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src scripts plugin.ts index.ts tests
scripts.format: oxfmt src scripts plugin.ts index.ts tests package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts plugin.ts index.ts tests package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun test tests/unit/ && bun run typecheck
